# Resolved dependency set for a DeepEval evaluator Lambda — hash-pinned, for scanning.
#
# Enumerates what actually reaches a customer Lambda: 7 declared pins resolve to 101
# packages. assets/requirements.txt lists only the declared ones, which is what a human
# reviews; this is what a scanner needs. Resolved for Lambda's target (CPython 3.12,
# x86_64-manylinux_2_28) under --only-binary :all:, so it is specific to that platform.
#
# Hashes ARE enforced: migration.sh copies this file to constraints.txt and exports
# UV_CONSTRAINT with UV_REQUIRE_HASHES, so the CDK's uv verifies every wheel, transitives
# included, before it enters the bundle. The pyproject alone cannot do this — hash mode
# rejects it ("all requirements must be pinned upfront with =="). A stale copy therefore
# FAILS the deploy rather than installing something unverified.
#
# Do NOT install from this file: it is the Lambda set, not the operator's (SKILL.md Step 0).

#   python3 -c "import deployer as d; print(chr(10).join(sorted(d.deepeval_lambda_deps())))" > declared-pins.txt
#   python3 -c "import deployer as d; print(d.DEEPEVAL_OVERRIDES, end='')" > ov.txt
#   uv pip compile --generate-hashes --only-binary :all: --python-version 3.12 \
#     --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_28 --overrides ov.txt \
#     -o <repo>/assets/requirements/deepeval.txt declared-pins.txt
